Adding my sketch — attached is a lightweight routing diagram (proposed-routing-diagram.png) and a one-paragraph template for outreach. Key rationale: split by product module rather than geography (Nexus uses multiple Redwood capabilities across infra and fine-tuning).

Highlights:
- Commercial negotiations consolidated under Marissa (pricing, SOWs, contract).
- Integrations & engineering work routed to Ben and his team (tech leads get direct calendar links).
- Alliance/referral credits managed by Vivek; Jonas will record any co-sell credit in the CRM so we avoid duplicate deal records.

Draft outreach (for Logan):
"Hi Emily — thanks for flagging this. To reduce noise and speed things up, we propose one commercial POC and a routed technical contact for product work. See the attached map; we can finalize MoUs next week and share a DocuSign link. Proposed commercial POC: Marissa Cole. Technical POC: Ben Carter"

If everyone agrees, I can send this to Nexus and include a suggested timeline for an MOU.

Marissa
Senior Alliances Manager
